<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>A 64-bit ripple carry adder implemented with pipelined stages. Each stage has its own register to store the inputs and outputs, enabling efficient computation.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal for initialization.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for initiating addition operations.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">First 64-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">Second 64-bit input operand.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">Resulting 65-bit sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
